explication: PureMac is a macOS care product with a SwiftUI app and a separate terminal CLI. The main GUI workflow is to scan for cleanup or app-related files, review selections, then remove chosen items; the CLI offers a similar scan–review–clean flow plus project cleanup and storage exploration. The graph also preserves documented app uninstall/orphan, monitoring, duplicate/photo, protection, and optimization capabilities. Several feature links are based on README descriptions; unsampled implementations are represented only where their paths are present in the tree.
